title: GraphAmbiCardio: a provenance-first knowledge graph of environmental exposures, molecular mechanisms, cardiogenesis and congenital heart defects
description: Computational study integrating structured literature searches, curated biological databases, SINASC/SIH data from Campos dos Goytacazes (RJ, Brazil) and ERA5-Land climate into a provenance-first knowledge graph of congenital heart defects. Individual-level health records are not redistributed; the repository contains code, aggregates, graph exports, metadata and a Shiny application.
notes: The version corresponds to the Git tag v0.3.0. A persistent DOI will be minted by Zenodo when this release is published; update CITATION.cff, codemeta.json and fair/metadata.json afterwards.
